title: Pilot Trial of Xylitol for C. Difficile De-Colonization in Patients With Inflammatory Bowel Disease
official: Pilot Trial of Xylitol for C. Difficile De-Colonization in Patients With Inflammatory Bowel Disease
summary: This 3+3 dose escalation pilot trial will assess the safety and efficacy of xylitol as an oral therapeutic for decolonization of C. difficile in the Inflammatory Bowel Disease (IBD) patient population.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Signed informed consent.
2. Male or female ≥ 18 years of age
3. IBD diagnosis (CD, UC or indeterminant Colitis will be permitted)
4. Inactive or mild IBD (HBI score ≤ 4; Partial Mayo score ≤ 4)
5. Presenting for outpatient colonoscopy or clinic appointment

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Unable to provide consent.
2. Patients with previous colectomy, ostomy, J-pouch, or previous colon surgery (excluding appendectomy)
3. Unable to complete study procedures.
4. Chronic use of antibiotics.
5. Inability or unwillingness to swallow capsules.
6. Allergy to xylitol.
7. Currently pregnant or breastfeeding
